eligibility: Full exact context freshly tokenized by same verified Qwen tokenizer with add_special_tokens=False/no chat template; >=32769 tokens; reject known ID/raw SHA; reject canonical first32768 input SHA matching identifiable historical same-tokenizer inputs; deduplicate remaining candidates by raw SHA and canonical32768 input SHA

project_metadata_audit: Try actual explicit repository/project fields, cached upstream metadata or unambiguous explicit source mapping by original ID/rawSHA. Do not infer project from content hash, imported package names, filenames or comments alone. Record search scope and absent evidence.

If mapping is absent/incomplete, PROJECT_INDEPENDENCE=UNKNOWN and choose first5 eligible distinct raw/input documents in fixed rank order.
actual_input: Full token sequence retained; save first32769 and actual consumed first32768. Zero-based consume ids[t], logits predict ids[t+1].
